title: 第6章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇欧慕瑄唇角勾起一抹淡笑，在绝世的脸上，优雅到勾魂摄魄，尤其是这么近距离的看着……愤怒，统统丢到了脑后，叶芊沫的小心脏跳动加速……“别怕，没事的。”轻柔的声音，在叶芊沫的耳边呵着暖气。一阵酥麻让叶芊沫的理智迅速回笼，怕个毛线啊，而且这位先生，本小姐跟你很熟吗？靠，这么纯熟的演技你当什么总裁，不去好莱坞闯荡一番实在对不起你这副伪善的嘴脸啊！气氛，瞬间安静得太诡异了。而这时，众多衣着光鲜的男男女女中，一个穿着青色连衣裙的女人站了起来。很别致的抹胸设计，不但将她小巧的身材衬托得更加凹凸有致，也遮掩住了她不够修长的缺点，反而显得小鸟依人，清纯可人，只是……叶芊沫看到她那一头亚麻黄的卷发，摇了摇头。“有问题？”欧慕瑄仿佛是随口问，然而眸子里明明有一抹一闪而过的狡黠。“她的发饰搭配有问题。”作为设计师，这点，叶芊沫有点强迫症，看不顺眼的，她就很想上去帮人家改一改。“你去改！”说完，放开一直禁锢住她的手。叶芊沫大方地走过去，脸上带着人女王般高高在上的自信，在众人的瞩目中，随手拿起一朵净白的百合，去掉叶子，咬在口中，然后双手熟练地将她的头发松松地挽起，用那朵百合花固定住。蹲在地上，撕开她衣服的下摆上的一层蕾丝，用极快的速度处理完毛边，在女人的腰间系成一个飘逸的蝴蝶结，很专业的手法，干脆利落，好像这样的事情，她早就已经做过千百次了。一切完成，叶芊沫将她拉到欧慕瑄的面前。“怎么样？”叶芊沫看着欧慕瑄，漆黑的眸子闪耀着明亮的光芒，眸波流转，尽敛世上所有的明媚，如一个傲世的女王那般，站在最高处，等着接受所有臣民的膜拜。她美得炫目，美得嚣张，美得主宰一切，不过，却也格外的刺眼！欧慕轩收回眼神，还是看不惯她嚣张的样子，不过此时，他分得清孰轻孰重，于是转头看向众人，“你们觉得呢？”此时，女人仿佛来自晨雾中的少女，带着清晨露珠的芬芳，娇小，但不柔弱，清雅又不失娇媚，只不过简单的修饰，竟完全改变了一件衣服的风格！在场的所有人都惊叹了，包括那个女人，莫含歆。“你……你是星空？”莫含歆也是设计师，所以对于眼前这个人，她几乎可以肯定，那就是国际顶尖服装设计星空！之前她以为那些报道都是子虚乌有的，都是欧慕瑄一手安排的，都是为了与她解除婚约的，没想到……居然是真的？！叶芊沫点点头，“不好意思，擅自更改了你的衣服，你选衣服的眼光不错，但请多注意细节！”欧慕瑄看着那些所谓的长辈们一个个惊愕的脸，于是开始觉得也许身边有一位这么带刺的玫瑰也不错，不过腹黑瑄是不会就此罢休的。“我为你介绍一下，”欧慕瑄指着莫含歆，“莫含歆，我以前的未婚妻，也是一位设计师，现在是欧氏集团设计部的总监。”以前的未婚妻？喂，那位傲娇的先生，你们的婚约还没正式解除吧？这瞬间就变成“以前”了？不过叶芊沫的听的重点却是……她也是设计师？不会吧？设计师会犯这么低级的错误？我去，难怪欧氏名下的女装业始终打不进国际市场。“我打算在设计部另设一个总监职位，由星空担任，含歆，以后星空有什么不懂的地方，希望你能多教教她。”开什么玩笑？星空啊，国际一流的设计师，让一个基本搭配都出错的设计师教？这摆明了是在华丽丽的嘲讽啊！“我们还有事，告辞！”欧慕瑄拥着叶芊沫的肩膀走出去，留下一众目瞪口呆的长辈还有一脸青白的莫含歆。走到无人处，叶芊沫一把甩开欧慕瑄的手，与他保持一段安全的距离，介于他个子高，胳膊长，叶芊沫又往后退了一步。然后伸出手，一副要账的样子，“欧总，戏演完了，我的报酬呢？”她的戏，的确很精彩，而她的才华，也的确值得她这么嚣张，不过……还是觉得刺眼！欧慕瑄斜身靠在墙上，修长的身体带着一层不容侵犯的冰冷，“看来你已经有条件了，说吧！”有多少奸诈商人的心里他都能看得透彻，更何况是一个女人。“听说欧氏旗下的娱乐公司欧皇娱乐，在国内的娱乐界首屈一指，我的好朋友顾佳泞正好合约期满，我想让她以九位数的身价签进欧皇，并且你们允诺全力包装。”“哦？”不为自己提条件，这点，倒是很新鲜，“我会让我的部门主管去考虑，不过你就不打算为自己提点什么条件么？”每个人的条件，都是先把自己放在第一位，很少有人像她这么傻。叶芊沫伸出自己的手，“我自己有手，想要什么，我会自己去努力，不需要靠别人！”漆黑的眸子，释放着盛大的光满，自信自立，傲然于世。欧慕瑄轻蔑一笑，她，还真的与众不同。“我还有朋友要等着我，失陪了！”叶芊沫转身，准备走回包间，然而走了几步，却又想起来，“对了，我不会去欧氏的，你死心吧！”欧慕瑄笑她的天真，“我会让你来的，而且，还是求我要你进欧氏！”“幻想！”求？她叶芊沫的字典里没有这个字！“星空小姐，你不是要去洗手间么？”欧慕瑄优雅的声音里带着一点戏谑。“……”叶芊沫停住脚步，这件连她自己都忽略了事情是怎么被他知道的？再说一个男人突然说这个是在耍流氓么？“你是怎么看出来的？”“五官！”“你是我长得一副内急的嘴脸？”靠，不带这么损人的吧？虽然她没顾佳泞美丽，但好歹也凑合着可以倾半个城吧？欧慕瑄并不回答她的话，只是一脸玩味的笑意，转身走向电梯的方向，消失前，好心地为她指路，“转身，直走，尽头左拐是女厕！”骂人不带脏，欧慕瑄，算你狠，下次给老娘等着！
content_en: Chapter 1 Meeting at the Bar A faint smile appeared on Ou Muxuan's lips. The peerless face was so elegant that it was so charming, especially looking at it from such a close distance... The anger was all forgotten, and Ye Qianmo's little heart beat faster... "Don't be afraid, it's okay." A soft voice blew warmth into Ye Qianmo's ears. A tingling sensation made Ye Qianmo's sanity quickly return to her senses. She was afraid of something. Besides, sir, do I know you very well? Damn, what kind of CEO do you think you are with such proficient acting skills? If you don’t go to Hollywood to try your luck, I’d be sorry for your hypocrisy! The atmosphere was so eerily quiet for a moment. At this time, among the many well-dressed men and women, a woman wearing a cyan dress stood up. The very unique tube top design not only made her petite figure more concave and convex, but also covered up her lack of slenderness. Instead, she looked cute, innocent and lovely, but... Ye Qianmo shook her head when she saw her flaxen curly hair. "Any question?" Ou Muxuan seemed to ask casually, but there was clearly a flash of cunning in his eyes. "There's something wrong with the matching of her hair accessories." As a designer, Ye Qianmo has a bit of obsessive-compulsive disorder. If she doesn't like something, she wants to help others change it. "Go and change it!" After saying that, he let go of the hand that had been holding her captive. Ye Qianmo walked over generously, with the confidence of a queen on her face. Under the attention of everyone, she picked up a pure white lily, removed the leaves, bit it in her mouth, and then skillfully pulled up her hair loosely with her hands and fixed it with the lily. Squatting on the ground, he tore off a layer of lace on the hem of her dress, processed the raw edges at a very fast speed, and tied it into an elegant bow around the woman's waist. It was a very professional and neat technique, as if she had done this kind of thing thousands of times. After everything was completed, Ye Qianmo pulled her in front of Ou Muchuan. "How is it?" Ye Qianmo looked at Ou Muchuan, her dark eyes shining brightly, her eyes flowing, capturing all the brightness in the world, like a proud queen, standing at the highest point, waiting to receive the worship of all her subjects. She is dazzlingly beautiful, so arrogant, so beautiful that she dominates everything, but she is also extremely dazzling! Ou Muchuan withdrew his eyes, but he still couldn't stand her arrogant look. However, at this time, he could tell what was more important, so he turned to look at everyone, "What do you think?" At this time, the woman seemed to be a girl from the morning mist, with the fragrance of morning dew, petite, but not weak, elegant and charming, but a simple modification, completely changed the style of a dress! Everyone present was amazed, including the woman, Mo Hanxin. "You...are you Xingkong?" Mo Hanxin is also a designer, so she is almost certain that the person in front of her is Xingkong, the world's top fashion designer! Before, she thought that those reports were all false and were all arranged by Ou Muchuan to break off the engagement with her. But she didn't expect... that they were true? ! Ye Qianmo nodded, "Sorry, I changed your clothes without permission. You have a good sense in choosing clothes, but please pay more attention to the details!" Ou Muxuan looked at the shocked faces of the so-called elders, and then began to think that maybe it would be good to have such a thorny rose beside her, but the sinister Xuan would not let it go. "Let me introduce you," Ou Muchuan pointed at Mo Hanxin, "Mo Hanxin, my former fiancée, was also a designer and is now the director of the design department of Ou Group." Previous fiancée? Hey, that arrogant gentleman, your engagement has not been officially terminated yet, right? Did this moment become "before"? But the main point of Ye Qianmo's listening was...she was also a designer? No way? Would a designer make such a stupid mistake? Let me go, no wonder the women's clothing industry under Ou's name has never been able to enter the international market. "I plan to set up another director position in the design department, and Xingkong will take the position. Hanxin, if there is anything Xingkong doesn't understand in the future, I hope you can teach her more." Are you kidding me? Starry sky, a world-class designer, let a designer who makes basic matching mistakes teach you? This is clearly a gorgeous mockery! "We still have something to do, let's say goodbye!" Ou Muxuan hugged Ye Qianmo's shoulders and walked out, leaving a group of stunned elders and Mo Hanxin with a pale face. When she walked to a deserted place, Ye Qianmo shook off Ou Muxuan's hand and kept a safe distance from him. Due to his height and long arms, Ye Qianmo took another step back. Then she stretched out her hand, as if she wanted to pay, "Mr. Ou, the play is over, where is my reward?" Her play was indeed wonderful, and her talent was indeed worthy of her arrogance, but... it still felt irritating! Ou Muxuan leaned against the wall, his slender body carrying a layer of inviolable coldness, "It seems you are qualified, tell me!" He could see through the hearts of many treacherous businessmen, let alone a woman. "I heard that Ouhuang Entertainment, an entertainment company owned by Ou, is one of the best in the domestic entertainment industry. My good friend Gu Jianing's contract has expired. I want her to sign to Ouhuang for a nine-digit price, and you promise to do your best." "Oh?" It's very novel not to put conditions for yourself. "I will let my department head consider it, but don't you plan to put some conditions for yourself?" Everyone's conditions are to put themselves first, and few people are as stupid as her. Ye Qianmo stretched out her hand, "I have my own hands. Whatever I want, I will work hard on my own. I don't need to rely on others!" Her dark eyes exuded a grand light, confident and self-reliant, and proud of the world. Ou Muchuan smiled contemptuously, she was really different.
